note: [L] states the limits in the matrix topology of the finite-dimensional comparator fields, equivalent to the operator norm, and for the derivative through `leaves` and `aisle` of the Parts. The rotation limit is stated for the normalized lie map; `rotation_lead` carries it with the `c⁻¹` normalization.

snippet.text:
derivatives (d : ℕ) : Bid.ConLap X b.sector.derivatives.deriv d (Free.scheme C.labels).deriv X.r
  rotations (i : Axis × Axis) (d : ℕ) : Tendsto
    (fun k => Spin.transport b.sector.turns.lie (X.U k d) i) atTop (𝓝 (Spin.attach (Free.gear C.labels) d i))

proof_context.conclusion: `derivatives` says `X.r k • X.aisle k d (leaves deriv d)` tends to the free derivative's `leaves`, and `rotations` says `Spin.transport lie (X.U k d) i` tends to the free generator `Spin.attach gear d i`.

{M : MaxwellData C} {X : Scaling S} (p : Supplier F V M I X) {c U J} (b : Tab S V M I p.uv c U J)
    (d j) : Tendsto (fun k => Spin.transport (c⁻¹ • I.Y) (X.U k d) j) atTop (𝓝 (Spin.attach M.T.K d j)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For the unnormalized current, `Spin.transport (c⁻¹ • I.Y) (X.U k d) j` tends to the Maxwell generator `Spin.attach M.T.K d j`.
